summary: Ordered collagen lamellae, ~90% of corneal thickness; faint blue-grey in an optic section, hazy when oedematous.

arcus_width.note: Radial width of the arcus band (used when peripheral_lipid > 0). Kanski's Clinical Ophthalmology, 9th ed.; render-calibrated (low).

lucid_interval.note: Clear gap between the arcus band and the limbus. Kanski's Clinical Ophthalmology, 9th ed.; render-calibrated (low).

scatter.note: Bulk backscatter of clear stroma. Render-calibrated.

scatter_tint.note: Short wavelengths scatter more, so the section looks blue-grey.

haze.note: Oedema or scarring; also blurs the view of the iris.

peripheral_lipid.note: Arcus: grey-white peripheral ring with a clear lucid interval at the limbus.

provenance.source: Thickness: Atchison & Smith (2000). Optical appearance: render calibration against slit-lamp photographs.
